title_sq: Tek "Lion Residences 2", Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Siperfaqe Te Bollshme!!!

title_en: At "Lion Residences 2", 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Area!!!
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, at "Lion Residences 2", super apartment 2+1 for sale!! The apartment is located on the fourth residential floor of a new complex under construction. Lion Residence 2 is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment is oriented to the East, which allows natural light during most of the day. The internal organization is as follows: the living room connected to the cooking area and with exit to the balcony, matrimonial room with dedicated toilet and exit to the balcony, another bedroom and the general toilet.
